# Integrations Overview

> Connect Zenflow to Github, Jira, Linear, Amplitude, Sentry, and more.

## Overview

<Note>
  Integrations require a Zencoder account. Extended catalog available to paid plans.
</Note>

Zenflow connects to the tools your team already uses. Connect each integration from the settings in Zenflow, then the AI agent can work with repositories, task trackers, do data analytics, error analysis and more.

## Pipedream Integration Catalog

In addition to our native integrations, Zenflow partners with Pipedream to offer an [extended integrations catalog](/zenflow/integrations/catalog) of over **2,000+ third-party integrations and APIs** (including [Salesforce](/zenflow/integrations/marketing/salesforce), [Supabase](/zenflow/integrations/development/supabase), [PostgreSQL](/zenflow/integrations/development/postgresql), [OpenAI](/zenflow/integrations/ai/openai), [Google Sheets](/zenflow/integrations/productivity/google-sheets), and more). This allows Zenflow agents to securely connect to virtually any external API or service with zero custom code required.

To browse and connect Pipedream integrations:

1. Navigate to **Connections** in the left sidebar of Zenflow.
2. Click the **"+ Connect more apps"** button in the top right.
3. Select any application from the **[extended integrations catalog](/zenflow/integrations/catalog)**.
4. Authenticate and authorize access.
